title: 8 Bedroom Wall Colors on One Paneled Wall, Navy to Alabaster
description: One bedroom, eight Sherwin-Williams colors from Alabaster to Naval, with codes and hex values, plus three peel-and-stick picks for renters who cannot paint.
dek: Same room, same light, eight wall colors. Browse them first, then pick the renter-safe pieces that fit.
constraint: Bedroom wall color, renter picks under $40
hook: A paint chip is hard to judge on a real wall. This guide shows one paneled bedroom wall in eight Sherwin-Williams colors, so you can compare how each one reads next to the same bed, wood and brass.

The images are AI-generated concept pictures, not photos of a real room. The code, hex value and light reflectance for each color come from Sherwin-Williams' own color pages, read Oct 25, 2026. Screens change color, so always test a sample on your own wall before you buy a gallon.
gallery_intro: Light reflectance (LRV) runs from 0 to 100. Lower numbers mean a darker color. The ceiling follows the room: warm white on the light colors, the same color as the walls on the three dark ones.
gallery_note: AI-generated concept images of one room. Colors are on-screen approximations of the paint listed under each look, so test a sample on your wall. They are not photos of a real room.

picks.name: Lenify Grasscloth Peel & Stick Wallpaper, Linen Texture (17.7 in x 118.1 in)
picks.alt: Illustration of a roll of peel-and-stick grasscloth wallpaper
picks.best_for: Renters who cannot paint: a textured accent wall
picks.why: A removable peel-and-stick roll, 17.7 by 118.1 inches, with a linen grasscloth texture. It adds color and texture to one wall without paint, which fits the lighter looks in the gallery.
picks.con: Test a small spot first, since how it comes off depends on the paint underneath. One roll covers a narrow strip, so measure your wall before you order.

picks.name: EZVALO Battery Operated Wall Sconces, Set of 2 (peel and stick, fabric linen shades)
picks.alt: Illustration of a pair of battery wall sconces with linen shades
picks.best_for: Warm bedside light on a painted wall with no wiring
picks.limit: Check how the adhesive holds on your finish
picks.why: Rechargeable sconces with fabric linen shades and a remote for dimming. They stick to the wall, so there is no wiring, and a pair flanks a bed the way the sconces do in the gallery.
picks.con: They stick on, so how well they hold depends on your wall finish. Check the listing for the adhesive notes before you commit.

picks.name: Command Heavyweight Picture Hanging Strips, 16 Pairs
picks.alt: Illustration of adhesive picture hanging strips
picks.best_for: Hanging art on a newly painted wall without nails
picks.limit: Follow the weight chart for each frame
picks.why: Adhesive strips for frames and wall art that remove without nails or holes when pulled as directed. Art is the fastest way to test a new wall color in a rental.
picks.con: Use the weight chart on the package for each frame. Fresh paint needs time to cure before strips go on, so check the paint can for its cure time.

final: If you buy one, make it the sconces. Lighting changes how every color in the gallery reads at night, and it works on any wall color. Add the grasscloth for an accent wall if you rent, and the strips for art once the wall is ready.
skipped: Paint and primer sold by the gallon, since color depends on your own sample test.
Any wall product that does not say it is removable or peel and stick.
Anything with no size or hanging details on the listing.
